name: Gobernación de Bolívar
body: A valid sitemap, structured data that parses, real 404s, and every internal link opened answered. But the server took over 4 seconds to send the first byte of the home page in repeated checks.
lesson: Cache the home page HTML on the server or a CDN so the first byte lands under 1 s.
summary: www.bolivar.gov.co scores 70 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 10 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 176 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /web/seccion/noticias/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 10 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 10 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 8 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /web/seccion/tramites/, /web/seccion/atencion-al-ciudadano/pqrsd/, /web/seccion/noticias/, /web/seccion/atencion-al-ciudadano/contactenos/ and 4 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
